reuseDecision.rule: SYS-001 adds a read-only, fail-closed projection over the existing immutable audit event store. It does not create an HRIS audit database, duplicate event ingestion, or an HRIS-local audit API.

uxContext.returnPathRule: The return target is a compiled allowlisted constant. No returnTo, redirect, callback, or browser-supplied path is accepted.

meaning: Select the closed HCM audit-evidence repository predicate and minimized DTO.
Preserve HRIS navigation context and the fixed safe return action.
productParameter.malformedPolicy: Missing product for an HRIS auditor, duplicate product, lowercase hcm, any non-HCM value, encoded ambiguity, or product on a non-HCM audit-control operation fails closed before repository access.

tabParameter.rule: An unsupported or duplicate tab is canonicalized to overview without selecting another audit-control capability.

focusParameter.meaning: An event identifier for the same tenant and same closed HCM evidence profile only.
focusParameter.rule: Malformed focus is rejected locally. Missing, foreign-tenant, or non-HCM evidence returns the same not-found presentation and never falls back to the generic Event DTO.

genericProfile.rule: The existing generic audit overview, event list, and event detail mappings explicitly require the product parameter to be absent.
genericProfile.hrisAuditorBypassRule: Any verified identity carrying HRIS_AUDITOR or HRIS_DUTY_AUDITOR is denied on every generic audit-control path and every write path. Removing product=HCM cannot expose the generic Event DTO, saved searches, cases, findings, exports, policy, or integrity controls.
genericProfile.nonHcmAdministratorCompatibility: A non-HRIS generic audit administrator with the existing exact permissions and no product parameter keeps the current API behavior.

physicalScopeAnchor.explanation: RS_HCM_CONFIG is the existing physical HCM product-root resource set created by the canonical APP_HRIS rename. SYS-001 reuses that stable product-root assignment boundary; its historical name does not grant configuration authority and no new resource set or seed migration is introduced.

allOf: Verified positive X-DWP-Tenant-ID and X-DWP-User-ID from the gateway identity plane.
Identity plane is TENANT and active access mode is ELEVATED. NORMAL may receive the existing step-up challenge but can never receive evidence.
No provider identity, provider-tenant evidence, delegated actor tenant, or support session is present.
APP.HCM:VIEW is present as a verified entitlement.
ADMIN.AUDIT_VIEW:VIEW is present as a verified permission.
HRIS_AUDITOR is present as the verified product access package role.
HRIS_DUTY_AUDITOR is the exact verified responsibility on APP.HCM in RS_HCM_CONFIG.
The product authorization decision grants hcm.audit.evidence.view for the exact route key and selected scope.
The route key is one of route.hcm.audit.evidence.page or route.hcm.audit.evidence-detail.data and was produced by the fixed product=HCM query binding.
Current decision revision, revalidate-at, context key, scope key, subject principal public ID, field-policy revision, and authorization revision are present and valid.
SOD_HRIS_AUDIT_INDEPENDENCE evaluates with no conflicting package in the same tenant product-root scope.
The service PEP recognizes the same v42 route binding and the closed response profile.

purpose.rule: The gateway strips browser-supplied purpose and rebuilds it only after an allowed exact route evaluation.

stepUp.generatorRule: The generator may omit stepUpCommandBindings only for the two explicitly allowlisted SYS-001 PAGE/DATA routes when every binding is GET, the sole profile is ELEVATED-only and readOnly, requiredAccess is the direct hcm.audit.evidence.view capability, and the response projection is closed. Every ACTION or other STEPUP capability keeps the existing exact command/object-version binding rule.

fieldPolicy.implementation: The HCM DTO is a compiled closed allowlist. A trusted positive current field-policy revision is mandatory, but no client field list can widen the projection.

scope.rule: The existing audit envelope does not carry an independently resolvable legal-entity or named-population key. SYS-001 must not infer one from actorRef, aggregateRef, or targetRef. If authorization produces no single eligible HCM product-root scope, the request fails closed. A future narrower population view requires a separately versioned canonical evidence contract and authority allocation.

segregationOfDuties.configurationAuthorRule: DATA_GOVERNANCE_READ or HRIS_CONFIG_AUTHOR does not grant audit evidence. A configuration author who also carries HRIS_AUDITOR is blocked by SoD rather than receiving a union of permissions.

emptyRawState: before_state is the empty JSON object
after_state is the empty JSON object
validation: aggregateRevision, scopeRevision, and fieldPolicyRevision are positive integers.
evidenceDigest and any beforeDigest or afterDigest are lowercase 64-character SHA-256 values.
classification is INTERNAL, CONFIDENTIAL, or RESTRICTED.
causationId and correlation_id are UUID values.
policy_id, source_service, source_module, target_type, target_id, actor_type, and actor_id are present.
DENIED or FAILED evidence has a nonblank canonical reason/error code.
canonicalFingerprint.rule: Rows that do not match the exact bounded HrisAuditOutboxEventV1 adapter fingerprint are excluded; source_module alone is never sufficient.

denied: actor, target, aggregate, display-name, principal, role, session, network, trace, raw state, or arbitrary metadata search
client scope revision or field-policy revision
filters.oracleRule: A filter over an omitted field is rejected rather than used as a hidden-field existence oracle.

minimizedResponse.rule: The generic AuditControlDtos.Event type is never serialized for product=HCM.

paginationReplay.rule: A continuation cursor replays the same frozen snapshot. A signature, tenant, authority, scope, policy, filter, route, or expiry mismatch is rejected before SQL. Counts are not returned.

tenantIsolation.list: Every list query includes the verified tenant predicate before the canonical HCM predicate and keyset predicates.
tenantIsolation.detail: Detail lookup includes verified tenant, event UUID, and the same canonical HCM predicate in one SQL statement.
tenantIsolation.cursor: Tenant ID is signed into the cursor and checked before repository access.
tenantIsolation.notFound: Cross-tenant and non-HCM identifiers have an indistinguishable 404 response.

frontendPresentation.hcmMode: A distinct HCM evidence component replaces generic overview metrics and generic AuditExplorer when product=HCM.
visibleContext: focus detail using the same minimized DTO
neverRender: generic correlations, findings, cases, exports, retention, legal-hold, or policy commands
frontendPresentation.errorBehavior: 403, 404, and 503 states retain the shared shell but clear evidence data and provide no generic fallback.

invariants: product=HCM is UX context and a closed projection discriminator only; it is never authority.
APP.HCM:VIEW, ADMIN.AUDIT_VIEW:VIEW, HRIS_AUDITOR, HRIS_DUTY_AUDITOR, server purpose, current field policy, current scope, current revisions, and SoD pass form an AND intersection.
NORMAL mode may obtain a step-up challenge but only a current ELEVATED decision may read HCM evidence; product=HCM never performs the elevation.
A data-governance configuration reader is not an HRIS auditor.
An HRIS auditor cannot remove product=HCM to reach generic audit data or any audit-control mutation.
Only existing PLAT-005 canonical events and SHARED-API-009 paths are reused.
No new store, CRUD family, migration, export, case, finding, saved-search, policy, or retention feature is added.
No raw or arbitrary audit metadata crosses the HCM response boundary.
Tenant, authority, scope, policy, and filter context are bound into every continuation cursor.
The feature remains fail closed until live HRIS_AUDITOR and HRIS_DUTY_AUDITOR assignment evidence exists through the existing governance runtime.
